verdict: The bounded cursor implementation is independently cleared for integration. No actionable Rust correctness, API compatibility, ownership, concurrency or unsafe-code defect was found. This does not clear application parity or complete acceptance. Formatting evidence and Showcase coverage require follow-up.
reviewed_contracts: All three new builders/adapters default off and use the existing FrameState cursor request machinery.
Cursor publication is clipped in the existing viewport projection and Ui path; retention takes an existing current-frame non-typing cursor from the registered immediate parent.

Top popover must be drawn, noninert and nonmodal; frame reset and final resolution reject stale, unregistered and moved-out-of-bounds owners. Layer identity is immutable within this paint, so no opening token is persisted.
Two different requested owners poison retention with a diagnostic; no last-writer-wins cursor selection.
An editable top-layer typing owner suppresses retained cursors even with no caret request. Ordinary focused top-layer cursors take precedence.
No new invisible production control, cursor stack, application painter or raw application cursor coordinate path was introduced. Existing strict retain_owner_cursor remains focus-dependent.
